title: Nana's More Tools
description: Some tool additions for useful historical and current usage with realistic material-working progression focus
body:
This mod will develop around different additions to Minecraft's vanilla tools improving multipurpose tool usage and accurate resource extraction methods.

The first mod addition was the pry bar, a tool that we use in limestone and hard-rock quarries for manual labor with no drills. With this you are be able to obtain stone, deepslate and gravel without silk touch. The second release adds the glass cutter, being the first glass-breaking efficent tool, greatly improving mining time for all glass blocks.
